name: regex
role: pattern matching — RegEx parsing for KXML token streams, schema validation, AIML guards, corpus filtering, and route condition checks
description: The Regex µ operates in the Gram face (grammar / structural correctness). It compiles pattern expressions against input token streams and returns structured match results. Used by other µ's as a sub-call for validation and filtering.

sampling.note: deterministic — pattern match has no sampling

invariants: pattern compilation is deterministic for the same input
capture group names are stable (no positional-only groups in schema validation mode)
DFA compilation is bounded (no exponential backtracking on adversarial input)
